about: Hand-written rotation guides for the warlock's player pages (guides.py).

raid.plan: You fight without a demon: before the pull you sacrifice the Imp with **Demonic Sacrifice**. In the fight you keep **Curse of the Elements**, **Bane of Agony**, **Corruption** and **Siphon Life** on the boss and channel **Wrack** whenever none of them needs putting back: while you channel it, your three damage-over-time spells tick twice as fast. This is the official simulator's own Aff (Wrack) rotation, played with its own build and options since 2026-11-19, with two changes from our rotation search of 2026-11-20: the curse and the dots come before the trinkets and potions, and Weakness Analyzer is used whenever it is ready (together +0.6% for this build in a full raid on a third seed). In a 3-minute raid fight: **Wrack** 28 channels, **Corruption** 10 casts, **Shadow Bolt** 8, **Bane of Agony** 8, **Siphon Life** 5, and **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse** and **Death Coil** about once each; **Wrack** 37% of the damage, **Bane of Agony** 26%, **Corruption** 23%, **Siphon Life** 7%, **Shadow Bolt** 6%.
why: Before the pull: **Summon Imp**, then **Demonic Sacrifice**: +15% Shadow damage for 2 hours (Forever swapped Classic's aspects, so the Imp is the Shadow sacrifice). Summoning any demon ends it, so you play the fight without one. The 11 Demonology points are there for the sacrifice: of the points on the way only **Fel Vitality** (15% more mana) adds anything, and the simulator finds no change without **Demonic Embrace** or **Demonic Aegis**. Then start a **Shadow Bolt** so it lands as the fight begins.

**Curse of the Elements** comes first, about once a fight: 5 minutes of 10% more magic damage taken, Shadow included (Curse of Shadow is gone in Forever). The simulator turns the raid's own copy of the curse off and leaves it to you. It is a Curse and **Bane of Agony** is a Bane, so both stay on the boss together.

Then the dots, each only once it is off the boss: **Amplify Curse** and **Bane of Agony** while more than 12 seconds of the fight are left, **Corruption** while more than 9 are left, **Siphon Life** while more than its own 30 seconds are left. **Bane of Agony** starts weak and builds up over its 24 seconds, so it is never refreshed early; **Amplify Curse** (off the global cooldown, a 3-minute cooldown, so once a fight) makes it 50% stronger and **Improved Bane of Agony** adds 10%. **Corruption** is instant with 5 points in **Improved Corruption**.
**Siphon Life** waits for the channel: the list never breaks a **Wrack** for it, and it holds it while Shadow Vulnerability, your **Improved Shadow Bolt** debuff, is on the boss.

**Wrack** is the filler. While you channel it, your **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** on the boss deal their periodic damage 100% faster (in the simulator every extra tick is a full one and each dot still ends when it would have), and **Soul Siphon** (3 points) adds 12% to **Wrack** for each of those three dots on the boss, up to 36%. So the dots go up first and you channel the rest of the time: **Wrack**'s own hits are 37% of your damage, and the three dots, which tick twice as fast under it, another 55%. A channel costs 200 mana for 6 seconds.
A channel ends early, after at least 2 ticks, when **Corruption** has fallen off the boss, or **Bane of Agony** has (with no **Bane of Doom** up): you put the dot back and channel again.

In the fight, **Shadow Bolt** only with a Shadow Trance: **Nightfall** (2 points) gives each **Corruption** and **Wrack** tick a 4% chance to make your next **Shadow Bolt** instant, and the list casts it before the next channel. Its crits put **Improved Shadow Bolt**'s 20% more Shadow damage from you on the boss for 12 seconds, **Wrack** and the dots included; **Malevolence** adds 5% to your Shadow crit chance, **Shadow Mastery** 10% to your Shadow damage, and **Pandemic** doubles the crit bonus of **Wrack** and your dots.

**Life Tap** only below 1,800 mana or 30% with more than a minute left, or when you cannot pay for anything else: 0.06 taps a fight in a full raid, so **Improved Life Tap**'s 2 points change nothing there. **Death Coil** (instant) goes in at the end, when a **Shadow Bolt** started then would land too late.
The simulated gear holds two on-use trinkets: Talisman of Ephemeral Power goes with the other cooldowns (twice a fight) and Weakness Analyzer whenever it is ready (once).
caveats: No demon: summoning any demon ends **Demonic Sacrifice**'s 15%. If you die, summon the Imp and sacrifice it again before the next pull.

Moving: **Wrack** is a channel and moving ends it. Your dots, **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse**, **Death Coil**, **Life Tap** and a Shadow Trance **Shadow Bolt** are instant: use them on the move, and channel again as soon as you stand still, since the dots tick faster only while you channel.

The simulator's authors measured in game how the faster ticks start when you begin a **Wrack** (their evidence note EV-0085); what happens at the instant a channel ends is their assumption, not yet measured.

Several targets (the simulated fights are one boss): with two or more the list puts **Bane of Doom** on your target while more than a minute is left, spreads **Bane of Agony** (on up to four targets, the first with **Amplify Curse**) and **Corruption** over the others, changing target to place them, and casts no **Siphon Life**.

Ranks: the list casts **Corruption** at rank 6 and **Shadow Bolt** at rank 9, the trainer's top ranks: the books for **Corruption** rank 7 and **Shadow Bolt** rank 10 are not in Forever on the evidence there is (2026-11-20; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09).

The official list also times Frozen Heart of the Mountain, a Major Spellblasting Potion and the racials Eureka! and Blood Fury to your dots (its **Siphon Life** line also waits while Blood Fury, the orc racial, is up). The simulated setup has none of them (a gnome with racials off, Major Mana Potions), so the list above leaves those conditions out.
The 30/0/21 builds under "Builds that play as a hybrid" play another list, SM/Ruin, which leads with **Bane of Doom** and fills with **Shadow Bolt**: see the Shadow Bolt hybrid page.
diverge: Near the end: the list starts no **Bane of Agony** in the last 12 seconds, no **Corruption** in the last 9 and no **Siphon Life** in the last 30. Keep channelling **Wrack**, and use **Death Coil** when a **Shadow Bolt** would no longer land.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters or **Curse of Tongues** on a caster boss.

leveling.plan: Affliction levels on its damage-over-time spells and the wand while the Voidwalker holds the mob: **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Immolate** on a healthy mob (**Siphon Life** from level 34), the wand while they finish it, **Drain Life** when you are hurt, and from level 40 **Wrack**, channelled while you have the mana. No **Shadow Bolt** and no **Fear**.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first: its **Torment** holds the mob while you stand at range. **Suppression** (levels 12-15 and 31) gives 5% hit and cuts your threat by 20%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. **Amplify Curse** (level 20) goes on whenever it is ready (3-minute cooldown): it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.

No **Shadow Bolt** once you own a wand. The re-tune of 2026-11-16 measured kills about a quarter faster without it at levels 20 and 30 (23.5 against 30.6 seconds at 20), and a check at level 10 found 15%. While the Voidwalker holds the mob, a bolt hardly shortens the fight: the dots and the wand kill it in about the same time. But it triples the mana a kill costs, and drinking that back took 3 seconds a kill at level 10 and 7 to 10 seconds at 20 and 30 in the fight lab.

**Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** (level 34) go on once each, none of them on a mob below about a third of its health: it dies before the spell pays for its mana. **Corruption** goes on only while you have more than 15% mana. **Immolate** only on a mob above about half its health, while you have more than half your mana: without bolts that is nearly every mob until 40, and from 40 **Wrack** spends that mana and the fight lab no longer casts it.

**Wrack** (level 40, changed by the hotfix of 2026-11-10) is a 6-second channel of Shadow damage, 60 a second at level 60, that makes your **Corruption**, **Bane of Agony** and **Siphon Life** tick twice as fast while you channel it. Channel it once **Corruption** is on a mob with more than a quarter of its health, and only while you have more than 30% of your mana: the re-tune measured that mana rule about 3% faster per kill. **Soul Siphon** (levels 32-33 and 41) adds 12% to it for each of your other Affliction effects on the mob, up to 36%. **Wrack** and **Siphon Life** are the build's two most valuable talents at 60: about 6.5 and 4.8 seconds a kill in the open search, three to four times **Suppression**'s five points.

**Drain Life** below 60% health, and in place of the wand below 85%. **Life Tap** in a fight only when your mana is down to about 15% and you stay above 60% health; between fights tap back to about 70% mana, and eat only below 55% health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
caveats: No **Curse of the Elements** while leveling: the re-tune of 2026-11-04 measured about 3% faster per kill without it (a global cooldown and mana on a mob that dies quickly), and the re-tune of 2026-11-16 kept it off.

No **Fear**: with the Voidwalker holding the mob the fight lab hardly needs it, and the re-tune measured kills about 0.7% faster without it over levels 20-60. At level 8, before the Voidwalker, dotting and wanding a mob that reaches you was 3% faster than fearing it. Keep it for a pull that brings a second mob.

This build has no Soul Link. Its 14 Demonology points (levels 42-43, 45-50, 53-56 and 59-60) are for the Voidwalker and for you: **Unholy Power** adds 10% to its damage, **Improved Voidwalker** makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 30% stronger, **Demonic Energies** heals it for 15% of your spell damage and gives it all the mana of each **Life Tap**, and **Demonic Embrace** adds 12% to your Stamina. **Bane** (58) takes 0.1 seconds off **Immolate**'s cast. **Destructive Reach** (51), **Curse of Exhaustion** (52), a curse this list does not cast, and **Grim Reach** (57) close the build, and the fight lab measures them at about nothing. The leveling filler passes of 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-23 moved the points that measured nothing at all into these, no slower in the fight lab.
Without **Shadow Bolt** Affliction spends little mana: the fight lab drinks well under a second a kill. When you are too hurt to **Life Tap**, drink below 15% mana.

When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** (level 42) if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage); otherwise keep dotting and wanding, with **Drain Life** when you are hurt, until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back.
diverge: Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new spell on it.
No wand yet (the first levels): **Shadow Bolt** fills until you buy one.
A second mob joins: **Fear** it (or **Banish** a demon or an elemental) and keep dotting the first; the single-mob list does not cover it.
Below about a third of your health with a mob on you, use a Healthstone (**Create Healthstone** between fights).

If the Voidwalker dies, summon a new one before the next pull rather than fight without your tank, and heal a hurt one between fights with **Consume Shadows** (not usable in combat) or **Health Funnel**.

raid.plan: Before the pull you sacrifice the Imp with **Demonic Sacrifice**, then fight with the Succubus out and **Soul Link** on; **Demonic Pact** keeps the sacrifice while she is out. In the fight you keep **Curse of the Elements** on the boss, cast **Bane of Doom** every minute while more than a minute is left, keep **Corruption** and **Immolate** up and **Demonic Brand** up with **Searing Pain**, and cast **Shadow Bolt** the rest of the time. This is the official simulator's own Demo (Shadow Brand) rotation, played since 2026-11-19 (+8.1% over the rotation it replaced on this build in a full raid), with two changes from our rotation search of 2026-11-20: **Death Coil** at the top of the list and **Life Tap** below 50% mana instead of 30% (+0.2% for this build on a third seed). In a 3-minute raid fight: **Shadow Bolt** 40 casts, **Searing Pain** 20, **Life Tap** 11, **Immolate** 10, **Corruption** 9, **Bane of Agony** 3, **Bane of Doom** 2, and the Succubus' Lash of Pain 15; **Shadow Bolt** 41% of the damage, **Corruption** 11%, **Bane of Doom** 10%, **Demonic Brand**'s hits 8%, **Immolate** 8%, **Searing Pain** 8%, the Succubus' melee 6%, **Bane of Agony** 5%.
why: Before the pull: **Summon Imp**, **Demonic Sacrifice** (+15% Shadow damage for 2 hours: Forever's Imp is the Shadow sacrifice), then **Summon Succubus** (6 seconds with 2 points in **Master Summoner**) and **Soul Link**. Open with a **Shadow Bolt** timed to land as the fight starts and **Corruption** right at the pull.

The Succubus earns her place: while she is out, **Master Demonologist** gives you and her 10% more Shadow damage, **Soul Link** 3% more damage and **Demonic Knowledge** 60 more spell damage (100% of your level). In the official simulator her attack power (17% of your spell damage) and spell damage (10%) follow yours all fight; her melee is 6% of your damage and her Lash of Pain 2%.

**Curse of the Elements** goes up first, about once a fight: 5 minutes of 10% more magic damage taken. The simulator turns the raid's own copy off and leaves it to you. As a Curse it sits beside your Bane.

**Bane of Doom** next, whenever it is ready and more than a minute of the fight is left: it deals its damage after exactly one minute, 10% of yours from two casts. It holds the Bane slot, so **Bane of Agony** goes on only while no Doom is on the boss and more than 24 seconds are left: in a 3-minute fight, after the second Doom lands.

**Searing Pain** ("Searing Pain for Brand") whenever **Demonic Brand** is off the boss or has under 2.5 seconds left: each cast brands the boss for 10 seconds, and the Succubus' next 6 attacks there deal extra Shadow damage. That is why the list casts it 20 times a fight: **Searing Pain** is 8% of your damage and the brand's hits another 8%.

**Corruption** (a 1.6-second cast with this build's one point in **Improved Corruption**) and **Immolate** go back up once they are off the boss, unless the fight ends before they would run out: no **Corruption** in the last 18 seconds, no **Immolate** in the last 15, no **Bane of Agony** in the last 24.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler because nearly everything you stacked is Shadow: the sacrificed Imp's 15%, **Master Demonologist**'s 10% and **Improved Shadow Bolt**'s 20% for 12 seconds after your own crits, and **Ruin** makes those crits deal double damage. **Bane** cuts its cast to 2.5 seconds, **Agonizing Flames** adds 10% to it (and to **Immolate** and **Searing Pain**), and **Decimation** 6% once the boss is below 35% health.

**Life Tap** (a global cooldown with no damage) below 50% mana while more than a minute is left, and in the last minute only when nothing else can be cast: 11 taps a fight. The list saves Talisman of Ephemeral Power for the last 15 seconds of a **Bane of Doom** (or a stretch with none up), and in a Doom's last 15 seconds it casts **Shadow Bolt** ahead of tapping.
At the very end: **Searing Pain** when a **Shadow Bolt** would no longer land, and **Death Coil** (instant) in the last 1.5 seconds, when not even a **Searing Pain** would finish.
caveats: If the Succubus dies, summon her again (6 seconds and a Soul Shard) unless the boss is about to die, and turn **Soul Link** back on: without her you lose **Master Demonologist**, **Soul Link**, **Demonic Knowledge**, **Demonic Brand**'s hits and her own damage. Never summon the Imp in the fight: that cancels your sacrifice even with **Demonic Pact**.
Threat: **Searing Pain** causes a high amount of threat. **Demonic Brand** halves it, but the brand's Shadow hits carry high threat of their own.
Moving: **Bane of Doom**, **Bane of Agony**, **Curse of the Elements**, **Death Coil** and **Life Tap** are instant; **Corruption** keeps a 1.6-second cast in this build.

Several targets (the simulated fights are one boss): with two or more, the list spreads **Bane of Agony** (on up to four targets), **Corruption** and **Immolate** over them, changing target to place them; with three or more it moves you within 5 yards and, once three stand that close, channels **Hellfire**, which burns you as well.

The official list also has a **Shadow Bolt** line for the Enchant Weapon - Revelation: its buff makes your next spell a critical strike, and the list spends it on a **Shadow Bolt** when Shadow Vulnerability, your **Improved Shadow Bolt** debuff, is off the boss or about to run out. The simulated weapon carries Enchant Weapon - Spell Power, so that line never fires and the list above leaves it out. The list's other cooldown lines (a Major Spellblasting Potion, the racials Eureka!, Blood Fury and Berserking) do not apply either: the simulated warlock is a gnome with racials off and drinks Major Mana Potions.

Ranks: the list casts **Corruption** at rank 6, **Immolate** at rank 7 and **Shadow Bolt** at rank 9, the trainer's top ranks: the class books' ranks above them are not in Forever on the evidence there is (2026-11-20; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09).

The list never casts **Soul Fire**, so **Decimation**'s Soul Fire half does nothing here; **Demonic Embrace** and **Master Summoner** only count toward the points the tree needs (the simulator finds no change without them).
diverge: In the last minute start no **Bane of Doom**: it would not land. In the last 24 seconds start no **Bane of Agony**, in the last 18 no **Corruption** and in the last 15 no **Immolate**: cast **Shadow Bolt**, then **Searing Pain** and **Death Coil** at the very end.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters.
If your threat nears the tank's, stop the brand's **Searing Pain** casts first: the tooltips give them and the brand's Shadow hits high threat.

leveling.plan: Demonology levels on the Voidwalker: its talents make the demon both the tank and a share of the damage (about a quarter at level 30 and an eighth at 60 in the fight lab, the brand's hits included), **Demonic Brand** (levels 28-29, 34) turns **Searing Pain** into extra Voidwalker hits, and your dots from the Affliction points and the wand do the rest. The page judges Demonology by what the demon adds, not by your own spells.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first: **Unholy Power** (levels 10-14), **Demonic Energies** (15 and 19), **Improved Voidwalker** (16-17, 24), **Demonic Knowledge** (31-33) and **Master Demonologist** (40-43) make it and you stronger, and **Soul Link** (30) moves 30% of the damage you take to it and adds 3% damage for both. **Demonic Sacrifice** (27) is only the step to **Soul Link**: never sacrifice your tank.

**Searing Pain** whenever the brand is gone, the Voidwalker is hitting the mob, the mob has more than a third of its health and you have more than 30% mana (the 2026-11-06 re-tune, about 1% faster per kill for each of the two limits): **Demonic Brand** makes the Voidwalker's next 2 attacks (at 28), 4 (29) or 6 (from 34) each deal 65 to 68 extra damage at level 60, and the brand halves **Searing Pain**'s own threat. The open search of 2026-11-20 measured the three **Demonic Brand** points at about half a second a kill at 60.

**Bane of Agony**, **Corruption** and, from level 60, **Siphon Life** on every mob above about a third of its health (**Corruption** only above 35%, the re-tune's rule, about 1% faster per kill). **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: common at level 20, rare once the brand costs mana from level 28.

The wand is your filler. **Shadow Bolt** and filler **Searing Pain** wait for 80% mana, and with the brands and dots you almost never get there: the fight lab casts almost no **Shadow Bolt** from level 30 and needs no drinking.

**Drain Life** below 60% health and in place of the wand below 85% (with **Soul Link** and the Voidwalker holding the mob, the fight lab rarely needs it); **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health. Between fights, **Life Tap** back to 70% mana, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows**, eat below 55% health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).

The Affliction points (levels 35-39 and 44-60) make your dots stronger: **Improved Corruption** (35-39) makes **Corruption** instant and adds 10% to its damage, **Amplify Curse** (50) strengthens a **Bane of Agony** every 3 minutes, **Pandemic** and **Malevolence** add to the dots' critical strikes.
caveats: This build has no Decimation and no Improved Health Funnel, so the **Soul Fire** and in-fight **Health Funnel** lines do not apply.

**Fel Vitality** (levels 18, 20-21: 15% more health and mana for the Voidwalker, 15% more mana for you), **Demonic Embrace** (22-23: 6% more Stamina) and **Demonic Aegis** (25-26: **Demon Armor** 30% stronger) fill the tiers on the way to **Soul Link** (30) and **Master Demonologist**. The leveling filler passes of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21 moved three points into **Fel Vitality** (0.1-0.2% faster per kill each), the fifth **Master Demonologist** point into **Suppression** (0.2%), and Improved Imp's three points, which only strengthen the Imp, into **Demonic Embrace** and **Improved Voidwalker** (no slower).
When a mob reaches you, cast **Death Coil** (level 42) if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage), otherwise **Fear** it and let the Voidwalker take it back.
The Affliction/Demonology hybrid plays this same list with other talents; its page and guide show the difference.
diverge: If the Voidwalker dies, finish the mob with dots, **Death Coil** and the wand, and summon a new one before the next pull: without a demon out you also lose **Demonic Knowledge**, **Soul Link** and **Master Demonologist**.
Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new dot on it.

raid.plan: Destruction in a raid keeps its dots and a bane on the boss and fills with **Incinerate**: **Bane of Doom** while its minute can still land, else **Bane of Agony** with **Amplify Curse**; **Immolate** and **Corruption** kept up; **Conflagrate** and **Shadowburn** whenever they are ready (each lights up **Shadow and Flame**: 20% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds after a Conflagrate, 20% more Fire after a Shadowburn); **Incinerate** otherwise. The Succubus stays out, **Demon Armor** is on and **Curse of the Elements** is your curse. 882 DPS in a full raid. This is the official simulator's own Destruction build and list (its Destro preset), which the page starts from since 2026-11-20.
why: Before the pull: **Demon Armor**, the Succubus out and **Soul Fire** as the opener. Bring Soul Shards: **Shadowburn** costs one, and the simulator starts each fight with 32.
**Incinerate** is the filler (40 casts, 35% of the damage): 25% more damage on a target with your **Immolate**, and **Bane** takes 0.5 seconds off its cast.
**Immolate** and **Corruption** kept up (12 and 10 casts; 13% and 12%): **Aftermath** adds 50% to Immolate's first hit, and **Improved Corruption** makes Corruption instant and 10% stronger.

**Conflagrate** whenever Immolate is up (16 casts, 11%): **Shadow and Flame** keeps your Immolate on the target and gives you 20% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds, and **Fire and Brimstone** adds 25% critical chance to it.
**Shadowburn** whenever it is ready (11 casts, 6%): instant, and through **Shadow and Flame** 20% more Fire damage for 20 seconds.

**Bane of Doom** (2 casts, 9%) while more than a minute of the fight is left, since it lands after a minute; then **Bane of Agony** (3 casts, 5%), with **Amplify Curse** for 50% more. **Curse of the Elements** sits beside the bane: 10% more Fire and Shadow damage.
**Life Tap** below 35% mana until the last minute; **Improved Life Tap** adds 20% to each tap. **Searing Pain** only when an Incinerate would not land before the boss dies.
caveats: This build keeps the Succubus out instead of sacrificing a demon: its melee and **Lash of Pain** are about 7% of the damage. If it dies, summon it again.
One **Curse of the Elements** per boss: if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid needs instead.
Moving: **Corruption**, **Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn**, the banes and **Life Tap** are instant.
Several targets: **Bane of Havoc** on a second target copies 15% of your damage to it; **Hellfire** and **Rain of Fire** for packs. The simulator's fights are one boss.
diverge: In the last minute no new **Bane of Doom**: **Bane of Agony** instead.
In the last seconds, **Searing Pain** in place of an **Incinerate** that would not land.
On two targets, **Bane of Havoc** on the second.

leveling.plan: Destruction levels as a nuker behind the Voidwalker, and the wand is the filler: between casts you wand the mob. **Immolate** on a fresh mob, **Bane of Agony** on every pull from level 8, **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana and the mob has more than 35% of its health, **Conflagrate** from level 31 (whenever it is ready from 39, when **Shadow and Flame** is 5/5) and **Shadowburn** (29) to finish. The wand does 35-45% of your damage from 10 to 30 and 22-28% from 39 (the fight lab, 2026-11-23): the tuned rules keep **Shadow Bolt** for spare mana and switch **Incinerate** off. The list casts no **Corruption**.
why: The Destruction points come first: **Bane** (levels 10-14) makes **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate** 0.5 seconds faster, **Destructive Reach** (15-16) adds 20% to the range of your Destruction spells, **Cataclysm** (17-19) makes your Destruction spells 10% cheaper, **Ruin** (20-24) doubles their critical strike bonus, **Agonizing Flames** (25-27) adds 10% to their damage and **Improved Shadow Bolt** (28) makes a **Shadow Bolt** critical strike raise the Shadow damage the mob takes from you by 4% for 12 seconds.

Send the Voidwalker in first and put **Immolate** on a mob above 30% of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker. From level 8 **Bane of Agony** goes on every mob (from 10 right after your opening **Shadow Bolt**), on a mob above 35% of its health: the tuned rules force it, from 20 since 2026-11-22 (6% faster per kill over levels 20-60 in the fight lab) and from 8 by hand since 2026-11-23 (11.6-12.5% faster at 8-9, 3-8% at 10-19), though it is 1.5-2% slower at 31-38 while **Conflagrate** still uses up **Immolate**.

With 5 points in **Shadow and Flame** (levels 35-39), **Conflagrate** no longer eats your **Immolate**, so cast it whenever it is ready on a burning mob; before that, cast it when **Immolate** has about 3 seconds left. **Shadow and Flame** also gives 20% more Shadow damage for 20 seconds after a **Conflagrate** and 20% more Fire damage after a **Shadowburn**; **Fire and Brimstone** (32-34) adds 25% critical strike chance to **Conflagrate**. Before **Shadow and Flame** 5/5 (39) **Conflagrate** uses up your **Immolate**: the fight lab is 4-6% slower a kill at 31-35 pressing it than holding it until 39 (2026-11-23). The page presses it as Destruction's signature spell; hold it until 39 if you only want speed.

Between casts the wand is the filler. **Shadow Bolt** only while you have more than 60% of your mana (the re-tune of 2026-11-21: 3% faster per kill over levels 20-60, 18% at 35) and never on a mob below 35% of its health (the 2026-11-07 re-tune, about 3% faster per kill). Finish with **Shadowburn** or **Conflagrate** when either would kill it; **Conflagrate** itself is cast only on a mob above a fifth of its health.

The same re-tune switched off **Fear** (about 5% faster per kill), **Drain Life** (about 3%), **Searing Pain** (about 1%) and **Incinerate** (about 3%). No **Life Tap** in a fight: with **Shadow Bolt** kept for spare mana the fight lab almost never needs one. **Corruption** stays off as well: forced in from level 20 it was 4% slower per kill (2026-11-22). Between fights tap back to 70% mana, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** or **Health Funnel**, eat below 40% health (the tuned rule). Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
caveats: **Suppression** (levels 42-45): 4% hit and 16% less threat keep the mob on the Voidwalker while you nuke, about 1.7 seconds a kill at 60 in the open search. **Aftermath** (41, 46-49) adds 50% to **Immolate**'s first hit, and **Unholy Power** (50-54), **Improved Voidwalker** (55), **Demonic Energies** (56-57) and **Fel Vitality** (58) make the Voidwalker stronger, and **Improved Life Tap** (59-60) adds 20% to the mana of **Life Tap**.

**Bane of Havoc** (30) is the step to **Incinerate** and does nothing here: this list fights one mob. The rules never cast **Incinerate** (40), but with it the list wands a burning mob instead of bolting it, which the fight lab measured faster: the open search of 2026-11-20 measured the build 1.8 seconds a kill slower at 60 without it.
When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** (level 42) below 60% health and let the Voidwalker's **Torment** take it back. The tuned rules never **Fear** it. A Healthstone below 35% health.
diverge: Start no **Immolate** on a mob below about a third of its health: finish it with **Shadowburn**, **Conflagrate** or the wand.
If the Voidwalker dies, summon a new one before the next pull: this list builds threat fast and needs a tank.

raid.plan: The Shadow Bolt hybrid takes Affliction's Shadow talents (30 points) and Destruction's **Shadow Bolt** talents (21), with no Demonology: no sacrifice, and the Succubus out all fight as a plain demon. In the fight you keep **Curse of the Elements** on the boss, cast **Bane of Doom** every minute while at least a minute is left and **Bane of Agony** after it, keep **Corruption** and **Immolate** up, spend each Shadow Trance on an instant **Shadow Bolt** before any dot, and cast **Shadow Bolt** the rest of the time. This is the official simulator's own SM/Ruin rotation, unchanged: adopted on 2026-11-19 (+1.4% / +1.6% over the rotation it replaced on this build in a full raid, seeds 1 / 2), and a rotation search from it the same day found nothing to change. In a 3-minute raid fight: **Shadow Bolt** 52 casts, **Immolate** 11, **Corruption** 10, **Life Tap** 10, **Bane of Agony** 3, **Bane of Doom** 2, **Curse of the Elements** and **Amplify Curse** once each, and the Succubus' Lash of Pain 15; **Shadow Bolt** 52% of the damage, **Corruption** 14%, **Bane of Doom** 10%, **Immolate** 10%, **Bane of Agony** 6%, the Succubus 7%.
why: Before the pull: **Summon Succubus** and put on **Demon Armor**. With no Demonology points she is a plain demon: 7% of your damage (her melee 6%, Lash of Pain 1%).

**Curse of the Elements** goes up first, about once a fight: 5 minutes of 10% more magic damage taken. The simulator turns the raid's own copy off and leaves it to you. As a Curse it sits beside your Bane.
**Bane of Doom** whenever it is ready and at least a minute of the fight is left: it deals its damage after exactly one minute, 10% of yours from two casts.
A Shadow Trance comes next: **Nightfall** (2 points) gives each **Corruption** tick a 4% chance to make your next **Shadow Bolt** instant, and the list spends it before any dot.

"Agony time": **Bane of Agony** takes the Bane slot only when neither Bane is on the boss and **Bane of Doom** cannot go up (on cooldown, or less than a minute left), and only while it beats "DPET Non DoT" (next line). In a 3-minute fight that is after the second Doom lands, about two minutes in. **Amplify Curse** (off the global cooldown, once a fight) goes just before it and makes it 50% stronger; **Bane of Agony** builds up over its 24 seconds, so it is recast only once it has run out.

"DPET Non DoT" is the damage per second of casting of your best direct spell (**Shadow Bolt**, **Searing Pain** or **Death Coil**). **Corruption** (instant with 5 points in **Improved Corruption**) and **Immolate** go on only while one cast of them, counting only the ticks that land before the boss dies, beats it: near the end of the fight they stop and you cast **Shadow Bolt**. **Corruption** is recast once it has run out, **Immolate** when less than its 1.5-second cast is left on it.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler: **Bane** cuts its cast to 2.5 seconds, **Shadow Mastery** adds 10% to your Shadow damage and **Agonizing Flames** 10% to your Destruction spells, **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate** among them; **Malevolence** adds 5% to your Shadow crit chance, **Ruin** makes its crits deal double damage, and each crit puts **Improved Shadow Bolt**'s 20% more Shadow damage from you on the boss for 12 seconds, your dots included. **Cataclysm** takes 10% off its mana cost.

**Life Tap** below 30% mana while more than a minute is left, and when nothing else can be cast: about 10 taps a fight, each 20% bigger with **Improved Life Tap**. **Pandemic** doubles the crit bonus of **Corruption** and both Banes.
caveats: The Succubus is a plain demon here. If she dies with little of the fight left, finish without her: **Summon Succubus** is a 10-second cast (this build has no **Master Summoner**) and costs a Soul Shard.
Moving: **Bane of Doom**, **Bane of Agony**, **Corruption**, **Curse of the Elements**, **Amplify Curse**, **Life Tap** and a Shadow Trance **Shadow Bolt** are instant.
Several targets: the list keeps **Bane of Agony**, **Corruption** and **Immolate** on up to 10 targets, by the same test as on one; the simulated fights are one boss.

Ranks: the list casts **Corruption** at rank 6, **Immolate** at rank 7 and **Shadow Bolt** at rank 9, the trainer's top ranks: the class books' ranks above them are not in Forever on the evidence there is (2026-11-20; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09).
The other setups at the top of the page (the 9/11/31 Fire build and the 22/11/18 Shadow Bolt build) play their own entries' lists, shown on the research rotation page.
diverge: In the last minute start no **Bane of Doom**: it would not land before the boss dies.

A boss needs only one **Curse of the Elements** (in Classic two never stacked): if another warlock keeps it up, take the curse your raid gives you, such as **Curse of Recklessness** for the physical fighters.
When healing is tight, each **Life Tap** costs health someone must heal: use your mana potion and Demonic Rune before you tap.

leveling.plan: A Shadow Bolt hybrid would level with the Destruction list: the Voidwalker holds the mob, **Immolate** goes on a fresh mob and **Shadow Bolt** is the filler. The list casts no **Corruption** or **Bane of Agony**: the Affliction points only make your Shadow spells stronger. No leveling page has a build for this split today.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first and put **Immolate** on a mob above about a third of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker. **Bane** and **Cataclysm** make every **Shadow Bolt** and **Immolate** faster and cheaper.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler only while you have more than 60% of your mana (the Destruction rules of 2026-11-21; the wand below that) and never on a mob below 35% of its health (the Destruction rules of 2026-11-07, about 3% faster per kill): finish it with the wand, or **Shadowburn** or **Conflagrate** where you have them.

No **Fear**, **Searing Pain** or **Drain Life**: the same rules measured the Destruction list faster without them. **Life Tap** in a fight is rare: with the bolt kept for spare mana the Destruction rules almost never run short; between fights tap back to 70% mana and eat only below 40% health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
caveats: Skip the lines for spells you do not have (**Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn**, **Soul Fire**).
When a mob reaches you, **Death Coil** if you are below 60% health, and let the Voidwalker's **Torment** take it back.
diverge: Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new **Immolate** on it.
If the Voidwalker dies, summon a new one before the next pull, and heal a hurt one between fights with **Consume Shadows** or **Health Funnel**.

leveling.plan: The 27/24/0 split plays the Demonology list without the brand: the Voidwalker holds the mob, **Bane of Agony**, **Corruption**, **Immolate** and from level 30 **Siphon Life** tick, and the wand fills. The Affliction points (levels 10-36) make the dots stronger; the Demonology points (37-60) make the Voidwalker stronger and end in **Soul Link** and **Demonic Knowledge**.
why: Send the Voidwalker in first: its **Torment** holds the mob while you stand at range. **Suppression** (levels 12-15 and 33) gives 5% hit and cuts your threat by 20%, so the Voidwalker keeps the mob. **Amplify Curse** (level 20) goes on whenever it is ready (3-minute cooldown): it makes that fight's **Bane of Agony** 50% stronger.

**Bane of Agony** and **Corruption** on every mob above about a third of its health (**Corruption** only above 35%, the tuned rule of 2026-11-06, about 1% faster per kill), **Siphon Life** from level 30. **Immolate** only while you have more than half your mana: with no **Searing Pain** brand to pay for, the fight lab casts it on most mobs at every level.
The wand is your filler: **Shadow Bolt** waits for 80% mana, which the dots leave you on some pulls before level 30 and almost never after, and the fight lab needs no drinking.

The Affliction points make the dots hit harder: **Improved Corruption** (16-19 and 23) makes **Corruption** instant from 23 and adds 10% to it, **Improved Bane of Agony** (21-22) adds 10% to the bane, **Pandemic** (24, 28 and 31) and **Malevolence** (25-27, 29 and 32) make your dots crit more often and harder, **Shadow Mastery** (35-36) adds 4% to your Shadow damage, and **Improved Life Tap** (10-11) adds 20% to each **Life Tap**.

The Demonology points are for the Voidwalker: **Unholy Power** (37-41) adds 10% to its damage, **Demonic Energies** (42 and 46) heals it for 15% of your spell damage, **Fel Vitality** (43-45) gives it 15% more health and mana (and you 15% more mana), **Improved Voidwalker** (48-49) makes its **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 20% stronger, **Soul Link** (57) moves 30% of your damage taken to it and adds 3% damage for both, and **Demonic Knowledge** (58-60) adds spell damage while it is out.

**Drain Life** below 60% health, and in place of the wand below 85%. **Life Tap** in a fight only when you are short of mana and above 60% health; between fights tap back to about 70% mana and eat only below 55% health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
caveats: This build has no Demonic Brand, so the list's **Searing Pain** line never fires, and no Improved Health Funnel, so the in-fight **Health Funnel** line does not apply: heal the Voidwalker between fights. **Demonic Aegis** (50, 52) only fills a tier, the Voidwalker taking the hits; **Improved Voidwalker** (48-49) makes **Torment** and **Consume Shadows** 20% stronger (Improved Imp's two points until the filler pass of 2026-11-23); **Demonic Sacrifice** (47) is the step to **Soul Link**; and **Soul Siphon** (34) only strengthens drains, which this list rarely casts.

When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** (level 42) if you are below about 60% health (it heals you for its damage), otherwise **Fear** it and **Drain Life** while it runs, until the Voidwalker's **Torment** takes it back.
diverge: If the Voidwalker dies mid-fight, finish the mob with dots, **Death Coil** and the wand, and summon a new one.
Below about a third of your health with a mob on you, use a Healthstone (**Create Healthstone** between fights).
Finish a nearly dead mob with the wand; start no new spell on it.

leveling.plan: A Demonology/Destruction hybrid would level with the Destruction list on a Voidwalker made stronger by about 24 Demonology points: **Immolate** on a fresh mob, **Shadow Bolt** as the filler, **Shadowburn** to finish. No leveling page has a build for this split today.
why: The Demonology points come first: **Unholy Power**, **Improved Voidwalker**, **Demonic Energies**, **Fel Vitality**, **Soul Link** and **Demonic Knowledge** make the Voidwalker a strong tank and add spell damage while it is out. **Suppression** gives 5% hit and 20% less threat.
Send the Voidwalker in first and put **Immolate** on a mob above about a third of its health, once it will not pull the mob off the Voidwalker.

**Shadow Bolt** is the filler only while you have more than 60% of your mana (the Destruction rules of 2026-11-21; the wand below that) and never on a mob below 35% of its health (the Destruction rules of 2026-11-07). **Bane**, **Cataclysm**, **Improved Shadow Bolt**, **Ruin** and **Agonizing Flames** make it faster, cheaper and harder-hitting.
**Decimation**: a **Shadow Bolt** on a mob below 35% health makes your next **Soul Fire** faster and free of a Soul Shard for 10 seconds; cast it then, while the mob has enough health left for it.

No **Fear**, **Searing Pain** or **Drain Life**: the Destruction rules measured the list faster without them. **Life Tap** in a fight is rare: with the bolt kept for spare mana the Destruction rules almost never run short; between fights tap back to 70% mana, heal the Voidwalker with **Consume Shadows** or **Health Funnel**, eat below 40% health. Whenever you sit down to drink or eat, do both while the other bar is not full: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17).
caveats: If the build has no **Conflagrate** or **Incinerate**, skip the lines that name them. **Improved Health Funnel**, **Master Summoner** and **Fel Domination** are steps to deeper talents.
When a mob reaches you: **Death Coil** (level 42) below 60% health and let the Voidwalker's **Torment** take it back. A Healthstone below 35% health.

If the Voidwalker dies, summon a new one before the next pull: without it you also lose **Demonic Knowledge** and **Soul Link**.
